title: Remediation report input
description: Input for `render.mjs finalize`. Text is plain text; `code` and **bold** are the only inline markup. Counts, the tally, the table of contents, total effort, row status and the colophon are computed, never authored. Cross-field rules are checked by the renderer and reported as report/* diagnostics.

output.description: repository-relative path of the report, e.g. docs/reports/remediation-<topic>.html

id.description: stable kebab-case ID; an update must keep it

language.description: BCP 47 tag such as en or es; languages without a locale file need labels

labels.description: interface label overrides keyed like locales/en.json

type.description: report type for the kicker, e.g. Security review

reference.description: ADR, PR or issue reference; omit when there is none

title.description: headline before the emphasized topic, e.g. Remediation plan:

tone.description: urgent (red) for pre-merge or incidents, info (green) otherwise

verdict.description: 2-4 sentences: overall state first, then what blocks, then the rest

when.description: when it must happen, e.g. Before merge

title.description: the concrete problem, not its category

effort.description: estimate such as ~15 min or ~1.5 h

problem.description: paragraphs: what happens and why it matters

summary.description: the product decision and its options

plan.description: 2-5 concrete steps naming real symbols and values

acceptance.description: a check runnable as a command, request or concrete inspection

resolution.description: set only after the fix landed and was verified: what changed and the verification actually run

rationale.description: why these findings share a commit (surface touched, dependencies)
